plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Geology AS-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8043/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61 = 15+16+14+16 (all semester headers match their rows; verified). GEOL 301 pre- or co-requisite per map: GEOL 300 (same semester; encoded as a prerequisite). GEOL 311 co-requisite per map: GEOL 310 (same semester; encoded as a prerequisite). MATH 400 pre-req per map: MATH 370 (not sequenced; carried under external_prereqs). CHEM 400 pre-req per map: Intermediate Algebra and CHEM 300, 305, 309 or 1 year of high school chemistry with lab (prior chemistry and algebra placement; documented here, not encoded as a plan prerequisite). CHEM 401 carries no prerequisite in the map's PRE-REQS column (transcribed as printed; it is sequenced after CHEM 400). Advisories (recommended, not required): GEOL 300 advisory co-req GEOL 301; GEOL 310 advisory GEOL 300 or 305; GEOL 311 advisory GEOL 300 & 301. CalGETC Area 4 footnote: a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines is required (one 3-unit Area 4 course sequenced in each of Semesters 3 and 4). Transferable electives: units needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. CalGETC Area 1A: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
